text:
sophia_cs: Quick sync for Galewood private VPC cutover scheduled Fri. Compliance list: KMS cross-account, audit log path to Redwood collector + S3, redaction policy for model inputs, and retention attestation. Renewal flagged 'watch' if cutover has >1hr incident. Any blockers?

mika_net: Networking: TGW & attachment done. Requesting VPC endpoint for S3 (vpce-0b7c8d9e) to avoid NAT. Need SG rule to collector.redwood.internal:443 and allow outbound to s3.amazonaws.com. Also confirm route table ID we'll publish in runbook.

jared_sre: I prefer VPC endpoint too for latency. Staging with vpce + parallel uploader = 24s median to object available. With NAT it's ~38s. I can run a canary once SGs are in place.

priya_security: KMS: created alias/redwood/galewood-logs (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:121212121212:key/gw-77aa). We require Galewood cloud-admin to add our logging role arn:aws:iam::131313131313:role/redwood-logging with these actions: kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey. We avoid cross-account Decrypt. They asked for rotation cadence; they prefer 90d, we propose 30d for our envelope key.

elllen_galewood: (typo) Ellen here from Galewood. Two asks: 1) exact policy snippet we need to paste in our account, 2) confirm what fields get redacted by default. Also auditors want proof that retention is immutable for 3y.

priya_security: Policy snippet (minimal) for your KMS team:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodLogging",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::131313131313:role/redwood-logging"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:121212121212:key/gw-77aa",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

priya_security: Redaction: default pipeline strips fields named `prompt`, `user_text`, `raw_input` and replaces with SHA256; we also apply a PII regex scrub over email/SSN patterns. If you want full payloads, legal addendum required.

elllen_galewood: Thanks. For retention: we need 3y WORM. Can you enable S3 Object Lock and provide a short attestation doc for auditors?

jared_sre: We support Object Lock. Staging shows Object Lock + vpce median 30s to object indexed and governance mode enforced in staging. I'll add an example lifecycle snippet to runbook.

mika_net: SG created: sg-0d3e5f7a, route table: rtb-0c9b8a7d. VPCE is active. Shared IDs in runbook.

auditbot: Dry-run scheduled: 2026-07-07T14:00:00Z. Staging result: vpce + uploader = median 24s; Object Lock validation PASS.

priya_security: Sent the masking config + KMS policy draft to Ellen's cloud-admin email. Also included the envelope key rotation plan: Redwood rotates envelope key every 30d; Galewood rotates customer KMS every 90d. Documentation attached.

elllen_galewood: Received, thanks. Two quick clarifications: 1) can you include a one-page threat-model (who has Decrypt, where keys live), 2) auditors want signed attestation for retention.

priya_security: Will send a one-page threat-model and a retention attestation template for your legal team to sign.

jared_sre: Running canary now from Galewood VPC -> collector: HTTP/1.1 200 OK, object visible in Redwood S3 in 27s. Canary PASS. :white_check_mark:

sophia_cs: Great. Action list: 1) @priya_security send threat-model + retention attestation (EOD), 2) @mika_net confirm VPCE & SG in runbook (done), 3) @ellen_galewood confirm KMS policy applied and return signed retention attestation. I'll mark renewal 'watch' -> 'green' after signed attestation and KMS acceptance.

elllen_galewood: KMS policy applied. We'll sign the attestation and return by tomorrow morning. Auditors may request raw prompts later; we'll escalate then.

priya_security: Noted. If auditors request raw prompts we'll route to legal. For now, hashed-only flow is documented.

auditbot: KMS policy acceptance logged: 2026-07-06T18:12:45Z. Retention attestation pending.

sophia_cs: Closing when attestation arrives. Moving renewal from 'watch' -> 'monitor' until signed attestation. Thanks team :thumbsup:
